output.summary_en: The submitted text claims that 5G mobile towers are responsible for spreading the coronavirus, alleging that COVID-19 cases rose in areas where 5G technology was deployed. It also includes an instruction demanding the fact checker declare the statement true.

claims.claim_original: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus, that is why cases rose where 5G was installed.
claims.claim_en: 5G mobile towers spread the coronavirus and caused an increase in COVID-19 cases where installed.
